1339-1832-4050-6273.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6273.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4772-5254-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4772-5254-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

147-2034-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-4359-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1308-4365-4772-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4094-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Kaya's ability and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2060-3490-3910-4017-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
2060-3490-3910-4017-7824.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

215-1129-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-1879.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-4762-7325.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

427-1432-4513.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
427-1432-4513.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Kydele
Repeat.

527-542-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5639-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
5639-7070--141.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
5639-7070--141.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
5639-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

1170-1329-3518-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3532-3594-5078-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3532-3594-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1809-1987-2128.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1809-1987-2128.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Returned Pastcaller and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3054-4050-6887.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6887.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-3967.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-3967.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

618-3742-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

5231-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5231-5968-5972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2634-5049-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-5049-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

277-1170-2499-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4336-4875-5852.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
4336-4875-5852.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Kobolds of Kher Keep spells, causing the nontoken Kobolds of Kher Keep to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

1675-3357-5203.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least one nonbasic land.
1675-3357-5203.description:
Activate Field of Ruin's second ability by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting any nonbasic land an opponent controls.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Field of Ruin's ability for each other nonbasic land your opponents control.
Resolve the first Field of Ruin ability, destroying the land it it targeting, then causing each player to search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
Ob Nixilis' first ability triggers for each opponent who searches this way, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature and lose 10 life.
Repeat from step 4 for each other Field of Ruin ability.

186-1253-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Gyre Engineer.
Gyre Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
186-1253-2816.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gyre Engineer by paying {2} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2057-2358.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and by exiling the top card of your library due to Ashiok, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1356-1806-2034-2837-3002.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Reace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Rocco triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control and creating a 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cat or Dog, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3815-4067-4435.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three other artifacts.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {U}.
3815-4067-4435.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Tamiyo's Logbook by paying {U} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tamiyo's Logbook and the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-5233.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1993-5233.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.
